title: Cross-region ingestion fanout and tenant-scoped placement policy
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: implement an ingestion-time fanout and tenant-scoped placement policy that ensures analytics events are stored and replicated only to regions permitted by a tenant's data residency profile. Background: customers require per-tenant geo controls (EU-only, US+EU, APAC allowed, etc.) for compliance and contractual reasons. Current console pipeline writes to a single global topic and performs downstream replication without tenant-aware gating, which risks cross-border persistence for sensitive customers. Scope: design and implement a policy engine that evaluates tenant residency tags at ingestion, emits events to region-specific topics (or drops/flags events for policy violations), and drives storage placement into region-tagged object stores and OLAP partitions. Key components: 1) Ingest proxy middleware (HTTP layer) to resolve tenant residency from metadata store and annotate events before publish. 2) Fanout router that writes to per-region Kafka topics (kafka-eu, kafka-us, kafka-apac) with idempotent keys to support dedupe. 3) Placement controller service that subscribes to per-region topics and writes to geo-scoped S3 buckets / BigQuery partitions with region-specific encryption contexts and KMS keys. 4) Residency policy catalog (small KV) with rules, TTLs, and overrides for legal holds. Constraints & non-goals: we will not migrate historical events in this ticket (handled in a separate migration ticket). We will not change public SDKs in this phase; only server-side enforcement. Trade-offs: synchronous resolution at the HTTP proxy increases tail latency ~5-20ms; mitigated with async cache and fallback to best-effort tagging. Stronger guarantees (strict synchronous block + NACK) were rejected for availability reasons. Consistency model: per-tenant eventual consistency across regions; writes are single-master at ingestion with fanout copies produced asynchronously. Auditability & compliance: every event will carry an immutable residency tag and an append-only audit record stored in the local region and the control-plane audit stream. KMS: region-specific CMKs will be used for payload-at-rest encryption; keys rotated per-region. Rollout plan: feature-flagged rollout starting with internal tenants (flag off), then opt-in customers (staged), then default-on for EU-only tenants. Monitoring: per-tenant replication metrics, policy-deny counters, tail-latency at proxy, end-to-end delivery SLAs. Rollback: disable fanout at proxy and fall back to the legacy global topic path, plus backfill suppression. Success criteria: 1) No events from EU-only tenants appear in non-EU stores for 30 days in staging. 2) Policy-deny rate < 0.01% for permitted tenants. 3) E2E ingestion p50 +20ms vs baseline. Links: design doc https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/ENG/Cross-Region+Ingest+Fanout, infra diagram https://tiny.redwood/ingest-fanout-diagram
